suite: Suite PR #563 (Product Blending Optimizer Full precision switch, stacked on #554)

advanced.append: Read the figures in the Product Blending Optimizer with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
advanced.why: The cards print cost to whole dollars, volumes to 1 decimal and shadow prices to 2; the prompt asks 4.
